title: Taiwan Travelogue
author: Yang Shuang-zi
review: I first knew of this book from Fuchsia Dunlop's post on Instagram. Read and finished it when I was Brussels, a few days after it won the International Booker Prize. A very fascinating backstory about the author and her twin sister.

title: Baby Boom
author: Yokoyama Yuichi
review: Colours, lines, shapes. Bought in 2025 at the Pagemasters Zine Fair.

title: Baskerville's Teardrop Explodes - A Selection of Books as Muses
author: John Morgan
review: Published posthumously by one of my favourite book designers. The book is simple and unassuming.
